test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.
A person who lives only for pleasure.
solution: The correct answer is: **Hedonist**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The word **"Hedonist"** refers to a person who lives only for pleasure and prioritizes enjoyment over all else. (आनंदवादी) • **Example:** A hedonist often seeks out luxurious vacations and indulges in extravagant experiences.
